info.description:
Cloud billing data synchronization service API documentation
Supports automatic synchronization of billing data from multi-cloud platforms like VolcEngine and Alibaba Cloud to ClickHouse database
info.title: Goscan API

get.description: Perform comprehensive system health check including database connection, task manager status, etc. (Note: this endpoint is not under /api/v1 path)

post.description:
Manually trigger WeChat Enterprise cost report notification, supports specifying analysis date, cloud provider list and alert threshold. Can be used for temporary notification needs outside of scheduled tasks.

**Request Example:**
```json
{
"date": "2025-09-12",
"providers": ["volcengine", "alicloud"],
"alert_threshold": 15.0,
"force_notify": false,
"test_mode": false
}
```

**Field Descriptions:**
- `date`: Analysis date, format YYYY-MM-DD, uses current date if not provided
- `providers`: Cloud provider list, supports volcengine/alicloud/aws/azure/gcp
- `alert_threshold`: Cost change alert threshold (percentage), range 0-100
- `force_notify`: Whether to force send, ignores alert threshold when true
- `test_mode`: Test mode, only tests connection without sending actual report when true

post.description:
Immediately trigger billing data sync operation for specified cloud provider. Supports multiple cloud providers like Volcengine, Alibaba Cloud, etc.
Supports configuring sync mode, time range, granularity and other parameters.
For AliCloud the granularity field picks the target table: monthly writes alicloud_bill_monthly, daily writes alicloud_bill_daily, both writes each. When it is empty the bill_period format decides instead (YYYY-MM monthly, YYYY-MM-DD daily). VolcEngine has a single table and ignores granularity.
The endpoint returns as soon as the task is registered; poll GET /tasks/{task_id} for the outcome.

parameters.name: sync

200.description: Sync task accepted, poll the returned task_id

400.description: Invalid request parameters or missing cloud provider configuration

409.description: A sync for this provider is already running

429.description: Too many tasks in flight, retry later

post.description: Create and asynchronously execute a new cloud provider billing data sync task. Supports multiple cloud providers like Volcengine, Alibaba Cloud, etc.

parameters.description: Task request parameters including task type, cloud provider, sync configuration, etc.
parameters.name: task

get.description: Get detailed information of a specific task by task ID, including task status, execution progress, error information, etc.

delete.description: Cancel running tasks or delete completed task records. Running tasks will be forcibly stopped.

404.description: Task not found or cannot be cancelled

description.example: Daily VolcEngine billing sync at 2 AM
Daily VolcEngine billing sync at 2 AM

bill_period.description:
A single billing period. The format also picks the granularity when the
field above is empty: YYYY-MM is monthly, YYYY-MM-DD is one day.

create_table.description: Create the target tables first if they are missing.

end_period.description: End of the inclusive period range.

force_update.description: Re-fetch periods that already have data instead of skipping them.

granularity.description:
AliCloud only, selects the target table: monthly writes alicloud_bill_monthly,
daily writes alicloud_bill_daily, both writes each in one run. Ignored for
VolcEngine, whose bills land in the single volcengine_bill table.

limit.description: Cap on records to sync; 0 means no cap.

start_period.description:
Start of an inclusive period range, used instead of bill_period to backfill
several periods in one task.

sync_mode.description:
standard fetches every period in full, sync-optimal compares record counts
and only fills the gap. Empty uses the provider default from the config.

use_distributed.description: Write through the Distributed table instead of the local one.

models.WeChatNotificationRequest.description: WeChat Work cost report notification trigger request, supports specifying analysis date, cloud providers and alert threshold

alert_threshold.description: Cost change alert threshold (percentage), triggers alert when cost change exceeds this value, defaults to system configuration value, range: 0-100

date.description: Analysis date, format: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to current date. Example: 2025-09-12

force_notify.description: Force send notification, when set to true will send notification even if alert threshold is not reached, defaults to false

providers.description: List of cloud providers to analyze, supports: volcengine (VolcEngine), alicloud (Alibaba Cloud), aws, azure, gcp, defaults to ["volcengine", "alicloud"]

test_mode.description: Test mode, when set to true only tests WeChat Work connection without sending actual cost report, defaults to false

enabled.description: Whether WeChat notification feature is enabled

models.WeChatTestRequest.description: WeChat Work Webhook connection test request, used to verify Webhook URL availability

custom_message.description: Custom test message content, maximum length 500 characters, defaults to system preset test message
custom_message.example: This is a test message from cost monitoring system

timeout.description: Connection timeout (seconds), range 1-60 seconds, defaults to 10 seconds

has_credentials.description: Note: AccessKey and SecretKey are masked for security
